description: Synthetic canonicalization vectors. The expected digest of every vector is a LITERAL: it was computed once from the published preimage rule (sha256 over `<domain>\0<canonical json>`) and pinned here, so the lane that reads these vectors compares the production function against a fixed truth instead of against a value it regenerates itself (a lane that regenerates the expectation it compares proves nothing - see F-322).

vectors.name: the key order of an object does not matter
the same value under another domain is another digest
a null and a boolean are hashed like any other value
